title: Mirabel and the Inheritance
author: Freya Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Voss, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
